info.title: dotnet-diff-coverage
info.description: Cross-references a unified diff with .NET coverage reports (Cobertura/OpenCover/LCOV) to surface uncovered lines introduced by a PR. Outputs console, JSON, and SARIF reports.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Cross-references a code diff with .NET coverage files to surface uncovered lines introduced by a PR.

options.name: --diff
options.description: Path to a unified diff (.patch) file. Use '-' to read from stdin.

options.name: --coverage
options.description: One or more coverage report files (Cobertura XML, OpenCover XML, or LCOV).

options.name: --coverage-format
options.description: Coverage file format: cobertura, opencover, or lcov. Required when --coverage is provided.

options.name: --coverage-path-prefix
options.description: Prefix to strip from coverage file paths before matching against diff paths. Use when coverage paths are absolute (e.g. /home/ci/repo/) and diff paths are relative (e.g. src/Foo.cs).

options.name: --output-json
options.description: Write JSON coverage-diff report to this file path. Use '-' for stdout.

options.name: --output-sarif
options.description: Write SARIF 2.1.0 report to this file path for use with GitHub/ADO annotations.

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Maximum allowed percentage of uncovered diff lines before exit code 1 (0-100, default 0).

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a JSON config file. Defaults to dotnet-diff-coverage.json in the current directory.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Suppress ANSI color codes in console output.
